ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

2. What is √36? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 7
   D. 6

3. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 19.6

4. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

6. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.6
   C. 29
   D. 23.7

8. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

10. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

11. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. Cannot tell
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 88
   C. 19
   D. 22

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 120
   B. 23
   C. 46
   D. 30

14. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

15. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

16. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
